name: Spectral TV
description: Build always-on virtual television channels from your Jellyfin library with weighted programming, sequential or random episode progression, promos, bumpers, commercials, station IDs, M3U streaming, and XMLTV guide data.
overview: Always-on virtual TV channels for Jellyfin

versions.changelog: Development beta for Jellyfin 12. Fixes Synology/Linux loading by excluding Windows native SQLite DLLs from the plugin package, plus weighted programming, filler pools, persistent playout, M3U/XMLTV Live TV integration, and dashboard controls.
